concepts.proposed_markdown: The Adyen website Terminal API checklist frames merchant implementation as test-account and terminal setup, architecture/payment-feature choice, test transactions and reconciliation, then a separate live-account application and signed contract. It says to consult Adyen before building a cloud integration and to inform Adyen if P2PE is required because different terminal software is supplied. These website setup gates are distinct from the exact-commit Postman request examples; the checklist does not establish account-specific enablement or current SDK-version behavior.

- [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-get-started-tapi-checklist]] — Adyen website checklist for test Terminal API integration, architecture, terminals, payment/reconciliation tests, and separate go-live application (2026-09-15 snapshot).
